_note: Copy to <project>/transcript/corrections.json. Applied by render_transcripts.py at render time; transcript/raw/*.json is never edited, so re-renders are reproducible and timestamps never move. Every entry here is invented. Keys starting with _ are comments.

speaker_map._note: Confirmed by ear, per session if needed: listen to the first minute and decide which cluster is the narrator. Values must match narrator.label / interviewer.label in book.yaml.

spelling._why: place name Whisper heard as a common word

drop_segments._note: Whole raw segments that are Whisper echoing the initial_prompt back as speech. Confirm each one first: re-transcribe that stretch with no prompt and check the phrase does not reappear.

scrub_inline._note: A prompt echo embedded inside an otherwise real paragraph: strip the echo, keep the speech. Matched against the paragraph text, which may contain [?word?] low-confidence markers.
